title: Edit Distance
description: Given two strings `word1` and `word2`, return the minimum number of operations required to convert `word1` to `word2`. Permitted operations: insert a character, delete a character, replace a character.

hints.content: 2D DP table where dp[i][j] is the distance between word1[0..i] and word2[0..j].
If chars differ, dp[i][j] = 1 + min(insert: dp[i][j-1], delete: dp[i-1][j], replace: dp[i-1][j-1]).

solution.explanation:
Levenshtein distance 2D dynamic programming.
Time Complexity: O(m * n)
Space Complexity: O(m * n)
